data.title: Endangered and Threatened Wildlife and Plants; Endangered Species Status for the Rio Grande Shiner
data.abstract: We, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (Service), propose to list the Rio Grande shiner (Notropis jemezanus), a fish species from the Rio Grande Basin in New Mexico, Texas, and Mexico, as an endangered species under the Endangered Species Act of 1973, as amended (Act). This determination also serves as our 12-month finding on a petition to list the Rio Grande shiner.
